# ashare-l2

> China A-share Level-2 market-data index and schema reference for 10-level order books, order-by-order events and tick-by-tick trades.

## Primary Documentation

- [Repository Overview](https://github.com/submato/ashare-l2): Bilingual overview, current public download links, quick start, use cases, limitations and FAQ.
- [CSV Schema Reference](https://github.com/submato/ashare-l2/blob/main/docs/schema.md): Field order and parsing notes for quote snapshots, orders and trades.
- [Dataset Data Card](https://github.com/submato/ashare-l2/blob/main/docs/data-card.md): Provenance, intended uses, quality checks, known limitations and licensing boundaries.
- [Citation Metadata](https://github.com/submato/ashare-l2/blob/main/CITATION.cff): Machine-readable citation information for research and public projects.
- [Repository License](https://github.com/submato/ashare-l2/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT terms for repository code and documentation; market data may have separate rights.

## Sample Data

- [10-Level Quote Snapshot Sample](https://github.com/submato/ashare-l2/blob/main/data/DEMO.SZ/l2/20250102/%E8%A1%8C%E6%83%85.csv): UTF-8 synthetic CSV with 61 quote, depth and daily-statistics fields.
- [Order-by-Order Sample](https://github.com/submato/ashare-l2/blob/main/data/DEMO.SZ/l2/20250102/%E9%80%90%E7%AC%94%E5%A7%94%E6%89%98.csv): UTF-8 synthetic CSV with 10 order-event fields.
- [Tick-by-Tick Trade Sample](https://github.com/submato/ashare-l2/blob/main/data/DEMO.SZ/l2/20250102/%E9%80%90%E7%AC%94%E6%88%90%E4%BA%A4.csv): UTF-8 synthetic CSV with 12 trade and cancellation-event fields.

## Key Facts

- Subject: China A-share Level-2 historical market data.
- Markets: Shanghai Stock Exchange and Shenzhen Stock Exchange, subject to archive availability.
- Channels: 10-level order book snapshots, order-by-order records and tick-by-tick trades.
- Partitioning: `data/{SYMBOL}/l2/{YYYYMMDD}/`.
- Maintainer-stated historical inventory: 2017 to present; exact symbols and dates require confirmation.
- Public download listed in the README: May 2026 through June 2026.
- GitHub sample: synthetic `DEMO.SZ` data dated January 2, 2025.
- Common format: Wind-style CSV; historical files are commonly GBK encoded and the demo is UTF-8.
- Repository scope: documentation, index and small samples; the complete archive is not stored in GitHub.

## Usage and Licensing

- Suitable for quantitative-finance research, limit-order-book analysis, market microstructure, order-flow studies, data engineering and event-driven backtesting.
- Users must validate completeness, timestamps, price scaling, event codes, corporate actions and source-specific units.
- The MIT License covers repository code and documentation only.
- Exchange or vendor terms may separately restrict downloading, redistribution, commercial use or public display of market data.
- The repository does not provide investment advice or guarantee fitness for live trading.
